description: Create a page rule (URL pattern + actions like cache_level, forwarding_url). Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

actions.description: List of actions to apply when the pattern matches.

id.description: Action id, e.g. forwarding_url, cache_level, ssl, always_use_https.

value.description: Action value (shape depends on the action id).

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

zone_id.description: The Cloudflare zone ID (32-char hex). Get it from list_zones.

name: create_page_rule
